clue.text: Flannel or what goes with it?

definitions.meaning: a flannel is a British face cloth, used along with a cake of washing bar

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses of flannel lead here: flattering talk is soft soap, and the washcloth pairs with a bar used for washing.

clue.text: Beams from sun, a long way

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for sun or Sunday
many miles is a long distance

explanation.surface: Sunbeams travel a great distance to reach us.
explanation.definitionFit: To beam is to grin broadly, so beams are broad grins.

clue.text: Zulu weaponry and South Africa revolts, a long story before independence

indicators.note: revolts means turns over, so the abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: a saga is a long story
I is the abbreviation for independence or independent

explanation.surface: A history of Zulu arms and South African uprisings leading up to independence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolts' turns SA into AS. An assagai (assegai) is a light spear used by Zulu warriors.
explanation.definitionFit: An assagai is a slender throwing spear of southern Africa, the classic Zulu weapon.

clue.text: As if crying alters distressing activity?

indicators.note: alters says the letters of the preceding words are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: Weeping as if in pain changes some upsetting pursuit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'alters' rearranges the ten letters of AS IF CRYING.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarifying means scratching or cutting a surface, and figuratively harrowing someone: a wounding activity.

clue.text: Worry and fright after snark's first vanishing

indicators.note: vanishing says a letter disappears from the word for fright

parts.note: a scare is a sudden fright

indicators.note: first picks out the opening letter of snark's

explanation.surface: A nervous moment as the snark, Lewis Carroll's imaginary beast, disappears from sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vanishing' removes S, the first letter of 'snark's', from SCARE.
explanation.definitionFit: To care can mean to be troubled or anxious, and a care is a worry.

clue.text: 16A takes in European place name

indicators.note: takes in means the portion word swallows the other pieces inside it

parts.note: the answer to 16 across means a portion, here a ration
to put is to place

explanation.surface: A share of something that absorbs a European place name.
explanation.walkthrough: '16A' points to the answer at 16 across (a share), here taken in its synonym sense of a portion; 'takes in' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: A good name is one's standing or repute in others' eyes.

clue.text: Guy on radio attacks two men at same time?

definitions.text: attacks two men at same time?

indicators.note: heard on the radio, so the name is taken by its sound in a non-rhotic accent

parts.note: Guy Fawkes, the Gunpowder Plot conspirator commemorated in Britain each 5 November

explanation.surface: A man on the radio launches assaults on a pair of opponents simultaneously.
explanation.walkthrough: In British pronunciation FAWKES and the answer sound alike. In chess a fork is one piece attacking two of the opponent's men at once.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess, a piece that threatens two enemy pieces at once is said to fork them.

clue.text: One with old James on a site for WWII1 battle

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
Jim is a short form of James

explanation.surface: A man joins old James at a famous Second World War battlefield.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue as held reads 'WWII1', a stray character for WWII. Iwo Jima was the Pacific island taken by US forces in 1945.
explanation.definitionFit: Iwo Jima is the Pacific island where US marines fought Japan in 1945.

clue.text: Ornamental trees by grand print works

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for grand, a thousand
ink is what print is made of; to ink is to print
goes means works or functions, as a machine does

explanation.surface: Decorative trees set beside a big printing works.
explanation.definitionFit: The ginkgo, or maidenhair tree, is widely planted as a decorative street and garden tree.

clue.text: Not done well after student's entered and marked

indicators.note: entered means the student's letter goes into the other word

parts.note: a botched job is one done badly
L is a learner, the crossword student

explanation.surface: A poorly done piece of work handed in by a student and then graded.
explanation.walkthrough: L (the learner plate letter) goes inside BOTCHED. 'marked' looks like grading, but here it means stained.
explanation.definitionFit: Blotched skin or paper is marked with irregular patches or stains.

clue.text: Offensive comment by sailor (not teetotal!) surrounded by water

indicators.note: not tee-total read as no Ts at all: every T is removed from both words

parts.note: an insult is an offensive remark
tar is a familiar word for a sailor

explanation.surface: A rude remark from a seaman who is no abstainer, out at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not teetotal' is read as 'not T-total': both Ts go from INSULT and TAR, leaving INSUL and AR.
explanation.definitionFit: Insular comes from the Latin for island, so it describes land with sea all round.

clue.text: Unadulterated cut meat is appropriate

indicators.note: cut means the end is chopped off the word for unadulterated

parts.note: pure means unadulterated
loin is a cut of meat

explanation.surface: Unmixed, freshly sliced meat is just the thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' docks the last letter of PURE. 'appropriate' is the verb meaning take, not the adjective meaning suitable.
explanation.definitionFit: To purloin is to steal, to take something for oneself, as appropriating does.

clue.text: It's important to forget wide -not many score

indicators.note: to forget means the word for wide is dropped from the word for important

parts.note: weighty means important or serious
W is the cricket abbreviation for a wide, a ball bowled out of the batter's reach

explanation.surface: It matters to forget a wide ball, as not many runs are scored.
explanation.walkthrough: W for wide is a cricket scoring abbreviation; drop it from WEIGHTY. A score is twenty, so four score is a modest number of scores.
explanation.definitionFit: A score is twenty, so four scores make this number, only a few of them.

clue.text: Stowing away, it's smart to hold onto what remains

indicators.note: to hold onto means the word for smart keeps the other word inside it

parts.note: to smart is to sting
ash is what remains after burning

explanation.surface: A stowaway finds it hurts to keep hold of the leftovers.
explanation.definitionFit: Stashing something is hiding it away for safekeeping, as when stowing it.

clue.text: Conservative ranks head touring Thailand for top places in navy

parts.note: rows are ranks or lines

indicators.note: touring means the headland word goes around the Thailand letter

parts.note: a ness is a headland, a head of land
T is the international vehicle code for Thailand

explanation.surface: A Tory leader tours Thailand looking for senior naval posts.
explanation.walkthrough: NESS (as in Loch Ness or Dungeness, a headland) goes round T to give NESTS.
explanation.definitionFit: A crow's nest is a lookout platform high on a ship's mast.

clue.text: To succeed remain firm after cutting it

indicators.note: after cutting means the word for remain firm has its last letter chopped

parts.note: to inhere is to remain fixed or abide permanently in something
taken as written

explanation.surface: To prosper, stay resolute once you have cut it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after cutting' docks the final letter; inhere is a rare verb meaning to exist permanently within something.
explanation.definitionFit: To succeed to a title or estate is to take it over as heir.

clue.text: Parisian darling said to do splits

indicators.note: said means the French word is taken by how it is pronounced

parts.note: cher is French for dear, an endearment heard in Paris

explanation.surface: A Parisian sweetheart is described as doing the splits.
explanation.walkthrough: French 'cher' (dear) is pronounced like the English verb meaning to divide up.
explanation.definitionFit: To divide something into portions among people is to split it up between them.

clue.text: Paid regularly for lettuce etc sandwiches fried in the middle

indicators.note: sandwiches means the salad word encloses another piece between its letters

parts.note: lettuce and similar leaves make up a salad

indicators.note: in the middle picks the central letters of fried

explanation.surface: Regular payment for lettuce sandwiches with a fried filling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lettuce etc' is a definition by example, and 'sandwiches' is the container signal: the middle letters of 'fried' are the filling.
explanation.definitionFit: A salaried worker receives a fixed regular wage rather than hourly pay.

clue.text: Some want him blessed — they offer some protection

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A wish that a man be blessed, as a form of safeguard.
explanation.definitionFit: A thimble shields a sewer's fingertip from the needle.

clue.text: Sped across top of roundabout like a Merc

indicators.note: across means the word for sped spans the other letter, holding it inside

parts.note: hied is an old word for hurried or sped

indicators.note: top of picks the first letter of roundabout

explanation.surface: A Mercedes car tears across the top of a roundabout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Merc' suggests a Mercedes car, but here it is a mercenary, a soldier paid to fight.
explanation.definitionFit: A mercenary is a soldier paid by a foreign army, a fighter for pay.

clue.text: Trouble with fish catches and lines

indicators.note: catches means the fish word holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a ray is a flat fish
to ail is to trouble

explanation.surface: Bother with a fish that is landed on the fishing lines.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway is a set of train lines, the tracks a network runs on.

clue.text: Sounds like globe flower's petals are so arranged

indicators.note: sounds like says the word for globe is taken by its pronunciation

parts.note: the globe is the world

explanation.surface: A globe flower has petals set out in a particular pattern.
explanation.walkthrough: 'globe flower' looks like a plant name, but 'globe' is the word heard and 'flower's petals' begins the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Whorled petals radiate in a ring round a stem, like the spokes of a wheel.

clue.text: Jack's not working on this (in Saudi Arabia?)

definitions.text: Jack's not working on this (in Saudi Arabia?)

parts.words: Jack's not working on this (in Saudi Arabia?)
parts.note: Jack is a sailor, who is off duty ashore on solid ground; and Saudi Arabia, which bans alcohol, is a place without drink

explanation.surface: A labourer is idle in the Saudi desert.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack (Jack tar) is a sailor, idle on shore leave; the bracket adds a second reading, since alcohol is banned in Saudi Arabia.
explanation.definitionFit: Terra firma, as opposed to sea, is where a sailor is off duty, and a country banning alcohol is teetotal territory.

clue.text: Kelvin heading off to pay bill for boiler

parts.note: K is the symbol for kelvin, the unit of temperature

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter of the word for pay bill is removed

parts.note: to settle a bill is to pay it

explanation.surface: Kelvin sets off to pay the invoice for a new boiler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' drops the S of SETTLE, leaving ETTLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A kettle is a vessel for heating water, something that boils.

clue.text: Waters, the majority being around island

indicators.note: around means the majority word goes round the island letter

parts.note: most is the majority
ens is a philosophical word for a being or entity

explanation.surface: Seas that mostly lie around an island.
explanation.walkthrough: ENS is Latin-derived philosophy for an entity, a common crossword piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To water a plant is to wet it, as dampening does.

clue.text: Heavyweight boxer mostly is of sound character

parts.note: a ton is a great weight

indicators.note: mostly means the boxer's name loses its last letter

parts.note: Muhammad Ali, the heavyweight boxer

explanation.surface: A heavyweight boxer is largely a man of sound character.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' docks the last letter of ALI. 'sound' is about musical quality, not soundness.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonal relates to tone, the quality of a musical note.

clue.text: A bulwark created by privates say?

indicators.note: say means the word for privates is taken by how it is pronounced

parts.note: the groin is the region of the private parts

explanation.surface: A defensive wall raised by army privates, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'privates' suggests soldiers, but here it is the body region.
explanation.definitionFit: A groyne is a low wall built out into the sea to check erosion, a protective barrier.

clue.text: Trust hard work and a bit of experience

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
op is short for opus, a work

indicators.note: a bit of picks the first letter of experience

explanation.surface: Faith built through hard work and some experience.
explanation.definitionFit: Trust and expectation both look forward with confidence that something will come.

clue.text: Neat communications log from outset — outstanding bit of script

indicators.note: from outset picks the first letter of log

parts.note: owing means outstanding, still to be paid

indicators.note: bit of picks the first letter of script

explanation.surface: A tidy record of messages kept from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Neat' is an old word for cattle, so their communications are moos.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat means cattle, and their calls are the deep moos of cows.

clue.text: Ham to carve when cooked

indicators.note: cooked means the letters are mixed up, as ingredients are

explanation.surface: Ham ready for slicing once it has been roasted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when cooked' rearranges TO CARVE. 'Ham' is the theatrical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A ham actor performs with exaggerated, theatrical gestures.

clue.text: Return of short Romany girls — good lookers?

indicators.note: return of means the shortened word is read backwards
short means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a Romany is a Gypsy
lasses are girls

explanation.surface: Gypsy girls come back: what lookers!
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' trims GYPSY to GYPS, and 'Return of' turns it into SPYG.
explanation.definitionFit: Telescopes are instruments for seeing far, so they are good for looking.

clue.text: Lied about not being engaged

indicators.note: about means the letters of the word are turned around into a new order

explanation.surface: Lied about not having a fiancé.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges LIED.
explanation.definitionFit: Unoccupied machinery or workers are inactive, not engaged in any work.
